people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before Yahweh continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: Every Sabbath day the bread is to be set out before the LORD on behalf of the Israelites as a permanent covenant.
translations.kjv: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.
translations.asv: Every sabbath day he shall set it in order before Jehovah continually; it is on the behalf of the children of Israel, an everlasting covenant.
